Peer Assessment Rubric

  • Diff Completeness & Precision (4 pts): The submission identifies all discrepancies between the two independent transcriptions without omitting subtle punctuation or capitalization variations.
  • Adjudication Evidentiary Rigor (3 pts): Every editorial decision is justified with explicit visual evidence from the IIIF image rather than arbitrary compromise.
  • Methodological Reflection (3 pts): The 300–500 word analysis insightfully discusses how double-keying eliminates blind spots that single-editor proofreading fails to catch.
